claims.text: The study varies hydraulic conductivity (K_H) by four orders of magnitude, impacting the drainage timescale and lateral water fluxes.
Sensitivity tests show that the parameters controlling lateral water fluxes are influenced by the hydraulic conductivity, indicating its importance in the model.
The study's results are sensitive to variations in hydraulic conductivity, as it affects the simulated ground thermal regime and water balance.
